title: A multi-stage computational pipeline and in vitro validation for the discovery of small-molecule translation inhibitors targeting the bacterial ribosome
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,18359-18373
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01785A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Merve Yuce, Ezgi Koman, Fethiye Aylin Sungur, Ayten Yazgan-Karatas, Ozge Kurkcuoglu
A hierarchical VS pipeline to target the bacterial ribosome PTC and in vitro translation assays identified Mitoxantrone as a potent inhibitor of E. coli protein synthesis, and Plerixafor, Olcegepant, and Ziritaxestat as lead compounds.
